tagline.en: Depth Anything V2 as a geometry prior — sharper, more detailed monocular depth from a single image.
tagline.zh: 作为几何先验的 Depth Anything V2——从单张图像获得更清晰、更细致的单目深度。

en: Depth Anything V2 is the second-generation monocular depth model in the Depth Anything line. Like its predecessor it predicts a dense depth map from a single image, with the V2 release known for finer detail and cleaner, more robust depth.

In WorldFoundry it is packaged as an independent depth prior. The large checkpoint drives the shared priors factory and is reused by the video-depth prior, so the same implementation supplies both single-image and video-oriented depth.
It runs through the shared geometry-prior pipeline: give it an image and it returns a depth estimate that downstream 3D and 4D stages can consume as a geometric prior.
zh: Depth Anything V2 是 Depth Anything 系列的第二代单目深度模型。与前代一样,它从单张图像预测稠密深度图,而 V2 以更细的细节、更干净稳健的深度著称。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它被封装为独立的深度先验。large checkpoint 驱动共享的先验工厂,并被视频深度先验复用,因此同一实现同时服务于单图与面向视频的深度需求。
它通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 运行:给它一张图像,它就会返回可供下游 3D、4D 环节作为几何先验使用的深度估计。

whenToUse.en: Choose V2 when you want the Depth Anything family's monocular depth with improved detail and robustness — a strong default geometry prior for single images and video-depth workflows.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要 Depth Anything 系列的单目深度,并追求更好的细节与稳健性时,选择 V2——它是单图与视频深度工作流中有力的默认几何先验。

notFor.en: As a prior it predicts depth rather than delivering a finished reconstruction, and it's tuned for standard images rather than 360° panoramas.
notFor.zh: 作为先验,它预测深度而非交付完整重建,并且是为标准图像而非 360° 全景调优的。

en: Second-generation Depth Anything with finer detail
Monocular depth from a single image
Shared implementation also powers the video-depth prior
zh: 第二代 Depth Anything,细节更精细
从单张图像获得单目深度
同一实现亦驱动视频深度先验
通过 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供
